notes.title: Like a Dragon Gaiden is Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]TIME TO PROTECT YOUR FUTURE[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/55469f230da888c08f572f198d094639a3a14bf8.gif[/img]

Once a legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu faked his own death and abandoned his name for the sake of protecting his family. Now, he is thrust into conflict by a mysterious figure attempting to drive him out of hiding.


[h1][b]STRIKE FEAR INTO ENEMIES[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/b763a2df14e89f222edcb1363ebebeb56984d443.gif[/img]

Dynamically switch between Yakuza style, aggressive moves powered by strength & flair, and Agent style, precision-based combat with high-tech gadgets. Strategically adapt to destroy foes.


[h1][b]ENDLESS ENTERTAINMENT AWAITS[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/ea8bd76e853b37bdb00ff20ee0509d2241b7cbfd.gif[/img]

Whether you're brawling in the Castle’s Coliseum battle arena, singing karaoke, throwing darts, or racing in the pocket circuit, the world offers a variety of immersive experiences.


[h1][b]BUY THE DELUXE EDITION[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/62fb701aae256fc16142e14599648f969b478f1f.gif[/img]


Purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition to get the Legendary Fighter Pack included with the game! Play as or alongside Goro Majima, Taiga Saejima and Daigo Dojima in epic battles inside the Castle’s Coliseum battle arena.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375550/Like_a_Dragon_Gaiden_The_Man_Who_Erased_His_Name/


[h1][b]CONTINUE THE STORY[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/a3aaec6714d1e1594457e299658f97a19bb564ae.jpg[/img]

Already hungry for more? Get ready for Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth. Experience an epic emotional drama and discover the fates of two dragons when it launches January 26, 2024. Pre-order now to get the Hero’s Booster Pack & Special Job Set.

notes.title: Update 1.08 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Yakuza fans![/b]

Patch 1.08, the latest update to Yakuza: Like a Dragon is live! We've included another free gift in the form of an Upstart Assistance Pack, as well as addressing issues reported regarding gameplay. Please see below for a full list of changes and bug fixes. Thank you to all the fans for your support!

[b]Changes:[/b]
-Adds an Upstart Assistance Pack as a gift.

notes.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon patch includes a missing battle feature
notes.content:
A missing feature has been restored to Yakuza: Like a Dragon in the latest patch: now you'll be able to see when enemies are weak to a specific attack. The latest patch for Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's newest crime game restores the 'Weak' text displayed above enemies' heads when you're about to use attacks that will do additional damage.

Unlike previous Yakuza games, Yakuza: Like a Dragon uses a distinctively JRPG-style turn-based battle system in combat. Your characters will learn various attacks as they take on new roles, and many of these are elemental. Up until now, you've had to rely on memory to know whether a particular enemy type is weak to a certain element, although you can always refer to the Sujidex for clarification outside of fights.

However, update 1.3 for Yakuza: Like a Dragon restores the 'Weak' text graphic that was intended to display over enemies' heads when they're susceptible to a particular attack type. This ought to make target assignment planning much easier for Ichiban Kasuga and his merry band of fellow heroes.
